goals.name: Build general full-body strength with spine-friendly loading
Improve trunk stability without loaded spinal flexion
Improve aerobic fitness with two low-impact cardio sessions per week

Anti-inflammatory eating: whole foods, vegetables, fruit, oily fish, legumes, nuts and seeds, adequate protein at each meal, olive oil as main fat, limit ultra-processed foods, refined sugar, and alcohol, maintain hydration

Sleep 7-9 hours nightly on a fixed schedule, wind down 60 minutes before bed with no screens, keep the bedroom cool and dark, take a 10-minute walk after large meals, limit caffeine after 12:00, and take one full rest day between strength sessions where possible
Estimate strength in week 12 with submaximal 5-rep tests on machine and dumbbell lifts, no true 1RM
